workingExample.en: Mark damaged bays and low spots on delivery routes separately. Agree alternate routes and reopening checks for each stage.
workingExample.zh: 分开标记破损车位与送货通道低点，逐阶段确认替代路线与开放前检查。

short.en: Record what to retain, remove or reinstate before handback.
short.zh: 在交还前列明保留、拆除和恢复事项。

intro.en: We turn a commercial fit-out or make-good brief into an itemised scope. We review existing finishes, tenancy requirements and access, then coordinate strip-out, repairs and reinstatement as agreed. We separate retained elements from removals so your manager can review the work before it starts.
intro.zh: 我们把商业装修或退租恢复要求整理成逐项范围，核对现有饰面、租赁要求和进场条件，再协调已确认的拆除、维修与恢复。保留和拆除项目分别标清，方便负责人在开工前确认。

kicker.en: A clear brief becomes a clear finish
kicker.zh: 清楚的需求，形成清楚的交付

deck.en: Commercial alterations, refreshes and end-of-lease work with retained and removed items clearly defined.
deck.zh: 将商业改造、局部翻新和退租恢复中的保留、拆除与完成项目逐项列清。

lead.en: We turn the proposed work into an itemised scope before organising a commercial fit-out or make-good project. We review the existing condition, tenancy requirements and available plans or photographs. Repairing a local finish, changing a workspace and reinstating a tenancy are handled as distinct briefs.
lead.zh: 我们先把需求整理成逐项范围，再安排商业改造或退租恢复，核对现状、租赁要求和已有图纸照片，并分别处理局部饰面修复、空间调整及租区恢复。

metaDescription.en: Gold Coast commercial fit-outs and make-good scopes for partitions, finishes, repairs and reinstatement, with staged access, variations and itemised handover.
metaDescription.zh: 黄金海岸商业装修改造与退租恢复，明确隔断、饰面、维修和恢复范围，安排分段进场、变化确认及逐项交付。

title.zh: 三类需求，边界各不相同

rows.en: Restore agreed damaged or tired finishes.
rows.zh: 修复确认的损坏或老化饰面。

rows.en: Change agreed partitions or interior elements.
rows.zh: 调整确认的隔断或室内构件。

rows.en: Plans, retained items and operational needs.
rows.zh: 图纸、保留部分和运营需求。

rows.en: Complete an agreed tenancy reinstatement list.
rows.zh: 完成确认的租区恢复清单。

rows.en: Landlord list, condition records and access.
rows.zh: 房东清单、现状记录与进场。

title.en: Separate what stays from what goes
title.zh: 把保留与拆除逐项分开

text.en: We identify the included areas, removal limits and repairs to retained construction. Services within or beside affected elements are recorded for the relevant coordination.
text.zh: 我们标明涉及区域、拆除边界和保留构造修复，并记录其中或旁边需要协调的系统。

text.en: Set substrate preparation, retained finishes and the patch boundary against the agreed appearance.
text.zh: 按约定外观确定基层处理、保留饰面和修补边界。

text.en: We map removal, making good around former fixtures, material movement and waste. Items outside the brief remain visible as separate decisions rather than being silently assumed.
text.zh: 我们明确拆除、原固定件周边恢复、材料运输及废物，超出需求的项目另行确认。

paragraphs.en: Put the agreed handback list next to a room plan. Mark fixtures to retain, remove or make good and where a patch has to meet an adjoining finish. Sequence access, removal, repairs, finishing and cleaning so changed scope can be approved before it is covered by the next trade.
paragraphs.zh: 把约定的交还清单与平面图一起核对，标出保留、拆除及恢复的设施，以及局部修补与相邻饰面的交接。安排进场、拆除、修复、饰面及清洁顺序，便于变更在下一工种覆盖前确认。

paragraphs.en: We compare the signed scope, the items that remain and the areas where services or fixings will be exposed after removal. Recording this before stripping out makes it easier to agree patching limits, retained finishes and the condition expected at handover.
paragraphs.zh: 拆除前，我们对照已确认范围和保留物，核对移除后会露出的设备接口与固定点。提前记录这些条件，便于明确修补边界、保留饰面和交还标准。

title.en: Use the records to resolve the brief
title.zh: 用现有资料把需求说清

text.en: Available drawings, photos and the landlord’s item list help identify ambiguities. We compare the brief with the accessible site condition before confirming quantities and scope.
text.zh: 已有图纸、照片和房东清单帮助发现含糊项；我们结合可检查现状确认数量与范围。

text.en: Confirm material, colour and sheen before ordering. Set work order and finish boundaries around supply and retained surfaces.
text.zh: 订料前确认材料、颜色与光泽，再按供货及保留饰面确定工序和施工边界。

title.en: A sequence from protection to handover
title.zh: 从保护到交付的工序安排

text.en: We agree access, retained items, work zones and necessary service coordination before removals begin. Deliveries and waste routes are included in preparation.
text.zh: 拆除前确认进场、保留项目、作业分区和系统配合，准备材料送达及废物路线。

text.en: We carry out the agreed strip-out, substrate repairs and coordinated work, recording discoveries that change the original scope before further work proceeds.
text.zh: 我们开展约定拆除、基层修复和配合工作，发现改变原范围的情况时先记录并确认。

text.en: We complete the agreed finishes and clean-up, then check the item list with your nominated representative and record remaining actions.
text.zh: 我们完成约定饰面和清场，与指定负责人核对清单并记录剩余事项。

title.en: Plan around the spaces still in use

paragraphs.en: An occupied office or shop needs a different sequence from an empty tenancy. We agree staff and customer routes, noise and dust-producing stages, access restrictions and areas being handed back between stages. Drying, curing and related trade attendance are considered when planning those boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 营业中办公室或店铺与空置租区的顺序不同。我们确认员工顾客路线、噪音扬尘阶段、进场限制和分阶段交还区域，并结合干燥、固化和相关工种进场安排。

title.en: Price the agreed list and close it out
title.zh: 按约定清单报价与销项

text.en: Quantities, preparation, retained conditions, material matching, access, phasing and waste affect the allowance. Investigation and additional findings are distinguished from agreed reinstatement.
text.zh: 数量、准备、保留部分现状、材料匹配、进场、分段和废物影响范围，调查及额外发现与已确认恢复分开。

text.en: We record completed items, agreed appearance and function checks, photographs where included and outstanding work. The handover describes the construction delivered against the approved list.
text.zh: 我们记录完成项目、约定外观和功能检查、相应照片及待办事项，按确认清单说明实际交付工程。

q.en: Can you quote from the landlord’s make-good list?
q.zh: 可以按房东的退租清单报价吗？

a.en: Yes. We compare the list with available records and site conditions, clarify unclear items and prepare an itemised scope for the work to be agreed.
a.zh: 可以。我们结合记录和现场核对清单，明确含糊项目并形成逐项范围。

q.en: Does a patched wall need repainting beyond the patch?
q.zh: 墙面修补是否需要扩大刷漆范围？

a.en: We review the existing finish, patch position and agreed appearance. Preparation, matching and the boundary of repainting are confirmed in the scope rather than assumed to stop at the damaged area.
a.zh: 我们核对原饰面、修补位置和约定外观，明确基层处理、匹配及刷漆边界。

q.en: What happens if removal reveals additional damage?
q.zh: 拆除后发现额外损坏怎样处理？

a.en: We record the finding and explain its effect on the work. Additional repairs, materials or changes are confirmed before being added to the agreed scope.
a.zh: 我们记录发现并说明影响，额外维修、材料或调整在纳入原范围前确认。

coverAlt.en: Interior lining and repair work
coverAlt.zh: 室内墙面与修复作业

strap.zh: 保留 · 拆除 · 恢复

leadTitle.en: Mark the retained and reinstated work clearly.
leadTitle.zh: 清楚标出保留和恢复内容。

caption.zh: 租区交还涉及的办公区域

caption.en: Joinery and existing finishes at an opening

title.en: Check the work against the handback list.
title.zh: 对照交还清单核对完工。

note.en: We record what is complete by room or tenancy area, along with approved changes and any unfinished item awaiting review.
note.zh: 我们按房间或租区记录完成内容、已批准变更和仍待复核的事项。

workingExample.en: Photograph retained finishes before removal work and mark where joinery, partitioning or services meet surfaces that stay. That record gives the team a shared basis for checking repairs at handover.
workingExample.zh: 拆除前拍摄保留饰面，并标记木作、隔墙或设备接口与保留面的交界。交接时以这份记录共同核对修补边界。

short.en: Schedule repairs around check-out, housekeeping and room release.
short.zh: 配合退房、客房清洁和交房安排维修。

intro.en: We organise repairs across guest rooms, reception areas, shared facilities and back-of-house spaces. We agree work zones and attendance with your manager so the scope reflects room access, guest movement and the facilities that need to stay available.
intro.zh: 我们安排客房、接待区、共享设施和后勤空间的维修，与负责人确认施工区域和时间，让工作配合房间进出、住客通行及需要保持开放的设施。

kicker.zh: 住客空间，日常运营。

deck.en: We coordinate guest-room repairs, common-area maintenance and staged updates around room access and the facilities your property needs to keep available.
deck.zh: 我们结合客房进出与设施开放安排，处理客房维修、公共区域维护和分阶段更新。

lead.en: A guest room, a busy lobby and a poolside terrace need different work plans. We separate the defect, the affected area and the conditions for returning it to use. Your manager receives a defined work list, agreed access arrangements and a record by room or shared area.
lead.zh: 客房、繁忙大堂和泳池旁露台，需要不同的施工安排。我们分别确认缺陷、受影响区域和恢复使用条件，为负责人整理工作清单、进场安排及按客房或公共区域划分的记录。

metaDescription.en: We coordinate guest-room repairs, common-area maintenance and staged updates around room access and the facilities your property needs to keep available.
metaDescription.zh: 我们结合客房进出与设施开放安排，处理客房维修、公共区域维护和分阶段更新。

title.en: From guest rooms to shared spaces

text.en: We scope door and hardware faults, damaged wall or ceiling finishes, sealant joints and fixed joinery. Water stains are recorded separately from the source investigation and subsequent finish repairs.
text.zh: 我们确认门及五金、墙面和吊顶饰面、密封接缝与固定木作的维修范围。水渍、漏水源头调查及后续饰面恢复分别记录。

text.en: Reception, corridors, amenities and shared doors are assessed with guest routes in mind. We identify surfaces to protect, access to retain and any temporary work boundaries.
text.zh: 接待区、走廊、卫生设施和公共门的工作结合住客路线安排，明确成品保护、保留通道与临时施工边界。

text.en: We connect agreed roof, drainage, lighting and air-conditioning work with the spaces affected below. Gardens, terraces and pool-surround paving are scoped by area and material.
text.zh: 我们将已确认的屋面、排水、照明和空调工作与下方受影响区域衔接，按区域和材料划分园林、露台及泳池周边铺装工作。

paragraphs.en: Make three work lists before booking a visit: guest rooms by room number, public areas by route or level, and food and beverage areas by trading window. A loose handle can use a vacant room slot. A bathroom joint needs a dry-out and cure allowance. Terrace work also depends on keeping a suitable guest route open.
paragraphs.zh: 进场前分三份清单：客房按房号，公共区域按路线或楼层，餐饮区域按营业窗口。松动把手可利用空房时段，浴室节点维修需要留出干燥与固化时间。露台施工还需确认客人可用通道。

title.en: One room, a defect list or a larger update
title.zh: 单间维修、缺陷清单与较大更新

rows.en: The fault, replacement part and any finish affected
rows.zh: 故障、替换配件及受影响饰面

rows.en: Room numbers, repeated items and material matching
rows.zh: 房号、重复项目与材料匹配

rows.en: Retained items, trade sequence and reopening conditions
rows.zh: 保留项目、工种顺序与重新开放条件

rows.en: A floor or defined shared area
rows.zh: 一个楼层或明确公共区域

title.en: Build the plan around actual access
title.zh: 以实际可进场条件排工序

text.en: Agree who provides keys, occupancy of nearby rooms and interruptions to power, water or cooling.
text.zh: 确认钥匙联系人、相邻空间使用安排及水电空调停用时段。

text.en: Furniture protection, dust control, noisy tasks and waste movement are included in the work plan. Related tasks are sequenced before final finishes.
text.zh: 施工安排包括家具保护、粉尘控制、噪声工序和废物转运；相关工作完成后再处理最终饰面。

text.en: We record functional checks, cleaning and any drying, curing or follow-up condition that still affects use.
text.zh: 我们记录功能检查、清场情况，以及仍影响使用的干燥、固化或后续处理条件。

title.en: Match the part. Respect the finish.

paragraphs.en: Door hardware models, laminate finishes, paint colours and existing equipment details help define what can be retained and what needs replacement. We identify matching limitations before agreeing the finish scope.
paragraphs.zh: 门五金型号、饰面板、油漆颜色和现有设备资料，有助于确认保留与更换范围。确定饰面工作前，我们会列明材料匹配条件。

paragraphs.en: A maintenance visit and a room refurbishment have different material and access needs. We itemise replacement parts, investigation and additional attendances where they form separate work.
paragraphs.zh: 日常维护与客房翻新对材料和进场的要求不同。需要单独安排的配件更换、调查及再次进场，会分项列明。

text.en: Room or area number, a short fault history and photographs of the item and its surroundings help us group the work.
text.zh: 房号或区域编号、简要故障经过，以及部件和周边照片，可帮助我们归并工作。

text.en: Tell us which rooms can be released, who controls access and the date the area needs to return to use.
text.zh: 提供可交出的客房、进场负责人，以及区域需要恢复使用的日期。

title.en: A clear record for the next shift

paragraphs.en: We identify completed items by room or area, note any parts still required and set out the agreed next attendance. The handover distinguishes completed work from areas awaiting a material requirement or further investigation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们按客房或区域列明已完成项目、仍需配件和约定的下一次进场。交付记录清楚区分已完成工作，以及仍等待材料条件或进一步调查的区域。

paragraphs.en: Hand rooms and public areas back in stages. Record cleaning, drying, checks and responsibility for reopening.
paragraphs.zh: 按阶段交还客房和公共区域，记录清洁、干燥、检查及开放负责人。

paragraphs.en: We separate rooms ready to release, rooms waiting on parts and areas that still need drying or a final function check. At reception, that distinction makes the handover usable: staff can see which rooms can go back into inventory and which access window to hold.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分开标记可交回的客房、等待配件的客房，以及仍需干燥或功能复查的区域。前台据此确认哪些客房可以重新安排入住，哪些仍需保留维修时段。

q.en: Can all work fit between check-out and check-in?
q.zh: 所有维修都能安排在退房和入住之间吗？

a.en: Agree room release requirements before scheduling hardware, coatings, sealants or shared-service work.
a.zh: 按五金、涂层、密封处理或共用设施作业确认交房条件，再安排进场。

q.en: Can several rooms be handled under one scope?
q.zh: 多间客房可以合并安排吗？

a.en: Yes. We group the agreed defects by room, identify repeated parts and arrange batches with your manager. Different faults remain visible as separate items so completion can be tracked room by room.
a.zh: 可以。我们按房号归并已确认缺陷、核对重复配件，并与负责人安排批次。不同故障保留独立条目，便于逐间确认完成情况。

coverAlt.en: Sunlit resort pool and guest areas
coverAlt.zh: 阳光下的度假村泳池与客用区域

strap.zh: 客房 · 公共空间 · 餐饮露台

leadTitle.en: One property, different work windows.
leadTitle.zh: 同一座物业，不同的工作安排。

note.en: We record what has been checked, where cleaning or drying is still needed, and who releases each space back to reception or the duty manager.
note.zh: 我们记录已检查内容、仍需清洁或干燥的部位，以及由谁向前台或值班经理确认空间重新开放。

checklist.en: Rooms on hold and release conditions

caption.zh: 酒店大堂饰面和通行空间

workingExample.en: Schedule hardware adjustments in an agreed booking gap. Record drying time and release checks for finish repairs by room number.
workingExample.zh: 五金调整安排在约定的订房间隙，饰面修补按房号记录干燥及放房检查。

short.en: Group shared-area defects by location and agree resident access.
short.zh: 按位置归类公共区域缺陷，约定住户通行。

intro.en: We work to the scope approved by your body corporate or property representative. We coordinate common-area access, resident notices and contractor attendance, then document what was completed. We identify the relevant building areas and boundaries when defining the job.
intro.zh: 我们按业主委员会或物业代表确认的范围施工，协调公共区域进场、住户通知及施工人员安排，并记录完工内容。确认项目时，我们核对相关建筑区域及工作边界。

kicker.zh: 公共空间，范围清楚。

deck.en: We turn common-area defects into defined work packages, with location records, approved access and completion notes for your property representative.
deck.zh: 我们将公共区域缺陷整理成明确工作包，为物业代表保留位置、获批进场安排和完工记录。

lead.en: We begin with the relevant building areas and the scope approved by your representative. Entry doors, corridors, external surfaces and water-related defects are recorded by location. This gives the property team a clear basis for decisions, resident coordination and staged completion.
lead.zh: 我们先核对建筑部位与物业代表批准的范围，按位置记录入口门、走廊、室外表面和水相关缺陷，为物业团队的决策、住户协调和分阶段交付提供清楚依据。

metaDescription.en: We turn common-area defects into defined work packages, with location records, approved access and completion notes for your property representative.
metaDescription.zh: 我们将公共区域缺陷整理成明确工作包，为物业代表保留位置、获批进场安排和完工记录。

text.en: We scope door hardware, wall and ceiling damage, fixed fittings and agreed amenity repairs. Each item identifies the part affected and the finish or operation to be restored.
text.zh: 我们确认门五金、墙面吊顶、固定设施及约定卫生设施的维修；每项列明受影响部件及需恢复的饰面或功能。

text.en: Reported roof, balcony, façade, paving and drainage issues are separated by building element. Access above, below and through occupied areas is recorded with the defect.
text.zh: 屋顶、阳台、立面、铺装和排水问题按建筑构件区分，缺陷记录同时说明上方、下方及使用中区域的进出条件。

paragraphs.en: On a common-area list, keep the address, level, side and defect number on each row. Identify which issues need a committee decision, a lot owner’s access or a manager’s approval. Check the applicable plan and agreed work boundary before combining a private defect with corridor repairs.
paragraphs.zh: 公共区清单的每一项写明地址、楼层、方位与缺陷编号，标出需要委员会决定、业主配合进场或管理方批准的事项。把专有区域缺陷与走廊维修合并前，先核对适用的物业计划和已批准范围。

title.en: A defect list that can be priced
title.zh: 可以用于报价的缺陷清单

rows.en: Building, level, door or marked area
rows.zh: 楼栋、楼层、门或标记区域

rows.en: What happens, when it occurs and any previous repair
rows.zh: 问题表现、发生条件及既有维修

rows.en: Defined repair, further investigation or proposed improvement
rows.zh: 明确维修、进一步调查或拟议改善

rows.en: Nominated contact, affected lots and approved work boundary
rows.zh: 指定联系人、受影响单元及获批施工边界

title.en: Confirm the element and the boundary

paragraphs.en: Queensland maintenance responsibilities depend on the scheme and relevant boundaries. We use the property information supplied by your representative when defining the work, including whether the item sits within the approved common-property scope.
paragraphs.zh: 昆士兰共同物业的维护责任与物业计划及相关边界有关。我们依据物业代表提供的资料定义工作，并核对项目是否属于获批公共物业范围。

paragraphs.en: A repair, an investigation and an upgrade are different decisions. We keep them visible in the scope, so a leaking area is not automatically priced as a full replacement and a requested upgrade is not buried inside routine maintenance.
paragraphs.zh: 维修、调查和升级属于不同决定。我们在范围中分别列明，让渗水区域的处理依据调查结果确定，也让新增改善项目单独确认。

text.en: We group related defects while retaining individual location references. Repeated hardware or finish requirements can then be checked together.
text.zh: 我们归并相关缺陷，同时保留每项位置编号，以便统一核对重复五金或饰面要求。

text.en: Your representative coordinates resident notices and access permissions. We identify work zones, material movement and any temporary change to normal routes.
text.zh: 物业代表协调住户通知和进场许可；我们明确施工区、材料搬运及正常路线的临时变化。

text.en: If opened-up areas reveal additional work, we record the finding and seek the nominated decision before adding that scope.
text.zh: 局部打开后如发现额外问题，我们记录现状，并向指定负责人确认后再增加范围。

title.en: What shapes the scope and quote
title.zh: 范围与报价的影响因素

text.en: Existing hardware, coatings, surface profiles and any retained components determine the repair detail and replacement options.
text.zh: 现有五金、涂层、表面型材及保留部件，会影响修复细节和替换选择。

text.en: Height, resident access, the number of affected areas, investigation and staged attendances are identified separately where relevant.
text.zh: 高度、住户进出、受影响区域数量、调查及分阶段进场等因素，会按实际需要分别列明。

paragraphs.en: Match completion notes and photos to the approved defect list. Record parts orders and follow-up checks separately.
paragraphs.zh: 将完工说明和照片对应到缺陷清单，另列配件订货与复查。

paragraphs.en: A location written as level, entry and element is easier to verify than a general request for the building. We match each item to the approved common-area scope, record who provides access and preserve a route past work where residents still need to use the building.
paragraphs.zh: 用楼层、入口和部件记录位置，比只写楼名更容易复核。我们将每项工作对应到已批准的公共区域范围，记录进场联系人，并为仍在使用建筑的住户保留可行通道。

q.en: Can we start with photographs and a committee defect list?
q.zh: 可以先提供照片和委员会缺陷清单吗？

a.en: Yes. Label the location and describe the symptom for each item. We use the list to identify defined repairs and areas that need inspection before the final scope is agreed.
a.zh: 可以。请为每项标明位置和现象。我们据此区分已能明确的维修，以及需检查后才能确认最终范围的区域。

q.en: Can repairs be split across several stages?
q.zh: 维修可以分阶段进行吗？

a.en: We can group the approved work by building, level or access window. Each stage needs a clear boundary, completion record and any conditions affecting the next stage.
a.zh: 可以按楼栋、楼层或进场窗口归并已批准工作。每个阶段明确边界、完成记录及影响下一阶段的条件。

q.en: Can we include an issue inside a lot on the same list?
q.zh: 专有区域内的问题能列入同一清单吗？

a.en: Record it separately and confirm who approves the investigation or repair using the property plan and relevant arrangements.
a.zh: 可单独记录，并依据物业计划与相关安排确认由谁授权调查或维修。

coverAlt.en: Apartment facade with shared circulation and balconies
coverAlt.zh: 带共享通行空间与阳台的公寓建筑

strap.zh: 公共区域 · 审批 · 通行

leadTitle.en: Organise defects before scheduling access.
leadTitle.zh: 先把缺陷和通行范围分清。

title.en: Close out against the approved list.
title.zh: 逐项核对已批准的工作。

note.en: We keep completed work and matters awaiting a resident, manager or committee decision against the same location numbers.
note.zh: 我们沿用同一组点位编号，区分已完成工作和仍待住户、管理方或委员会确认的事项。

checklist.zh: 带编号的点位与标注图

caption.zh: 共同物业室外铺装与通行

workingExample.en: For several defects along a shared corridor, match each item to its location and approved scope. Agree the route residents will use during the work and who verifies the area before barriers are removed.
workingExample.zh: 公共走廊有多处缺陷时，逐项对应位置与批准范围。先确认施工期间住户如何通行，以及撤除隔挡前由谁核对。

short.en: Plan maintenance around service periods, deliveries and seating.
short.zh: 配合营业、送货和餐位安排维护。

intro.en: We plan maintenance for dining areas, amenities, entrances and back-of-house spaces around the way your venue operates. We confirm work zones, services affected and clean-up requirements before attendance, and separate routine repairs from larger changes to the premises.
intro.zh: 我们按门店运营方式安排用餐区、卫生间、入口及后勤空间维护，进场前确认施工区域、受影响系统和清场要求，并区分日常维修与较大场所改造。

kicker.zh: 营业节奏，施工有序。

deck.en: We plan repairs to dining areas, amenities, entrances and agreed building services around preparation, deliveries and the parts of your venue in use.
deck.zh: 我们结合备餐、送货和在用区域，安排用餐区、卫生间、入口及约定建筑设施的维修。

lead.en: A leaking fitting behind the counter and a repair across the customer entrance affect the venue in different ways. We define the work area, the service interruption and the clean-up required before agreeing attendance. Small faults and larger refreshes receive their own scope.
lead.zh: 吧台后方漏水与顾客入口维修，对经营的影响不同。我们在安排进场前确认工作区域、设施停用和清场要求，并分别确定小故障与较大翻新的工作范围。

metaDescription.en: We plan repairs to dining areas, amenities, entrances and agreed building services around preparation, deliveries and the parts of your venue in use.
metaDescription.zh: 我们结合备餐、送货和在用区域，安排用餐区、卫生间、入口及约定建筑设施的维修。

title.en: Front of house. Back of house. Outside.

text.en: We scope doors, walls, ceilings, lighting, amenities and fixed fittings. Visible finishes are checked for matching, and the customer route is considered alongside the repair.
text.zh: 我们确认门、墙面、吊顶、照明、卫生设施与固定配件的工作；核对可见饰面匹配，并同时安排顾客通道。

text.en: Agreed water, hot-water and drainage faults are recorded by fixture and location. We identify the effect of isolating a service before work begins.
text.zh: 约定供水、热水和排水故障按设备与位置记录，施工前先明确相关设施暂停使用的影响。

text.en: We review the agreed paving, entrance, fixed items and drainage points with tables, deliveries and pedestrian movement in mind.
text.zh: 我们结合桌椅、送货与行人路线，核对已确认的铺装、入口、固定设施和排水点。

paragraphs.en: Distinguish a loose threshold on the customer route from a leaking fixture or slow drain in the back of house. Reserve enough time for clean-up and returning equipment before service. If dining occupies public land, check the approved layout before moving seating or narrowing the pedestrian route.
paragraphs.zh: 区分顾客通道上松动的门槛，和后场用水器具漏水或排水缓慢。开餐前留够清洁和设备复位时间。室外餐位如位于公共用地，移动座位或调整人行通道前核对已批准布置。

title.en: Match the job to the operating window

rows.en: Access to the item, neighbouring stock and any service isolation
rows.zh: 部件进出、附近物品保护及设施停用

rows.en: Protection, preparation, material requirements and return-to-use conditions
rows.zh: 保护、基层准备、材料要求与恢复使用条件

rows.en: Tables, customer access, deliveries and the unavailable area
rows.zh: 桌椅、顾客通行、送货与暂停区域

title.en: Agree the sequence with your manager

text.en: We confirm the area available, nearby preparation or service activity and the nominated contact for access and decisions.
text.zh: 我们核对可施工区域、附近备餐或营业活动，以及进场和工作决定的联系人。

text.en: Building repairs, plumbing, electrical work and final finishes are sequenced according to the agreed scope. Waste removal and cleaning are included in the plan.
text.zh: 建筑维修、水管、电气和最终饰面按确认范围排定顺序，同时安排废物转运和清场。

text.en: We record completed work and any material, testing or follow-up condition that remains before the affected area returns to normal use.
text.zh: 我们记录已完成工作，以及受影响区域恢复正常使用前仍需满足的材料、检查或后续处理条件。

title.en: Keep the outdoor layout in the brief

paragraphs.en: For roadside dining on public land, the existing permitted layout and pedestrian clearances form part of the information to confirm. A private terrace needs its own site and property requirements checked. We identify which setting applies before defining the affected area.
paragraphs.zh: 公共土地上的路边餐饮，需确认现有获准布局和行人通道条件；私人露台则核对自身场地与物业要求。我们先明确适用场景，再界定受影响区域。

paragraphs.en: We separate washing, a local paving repair and a change to drainage. Each has different access, material and waste-water arrangements; one task is not assumed to resolve the others.
paragraphs.zh: 清洗、局部铺装修补和排水改变分别确认，各自对应不同进场、材料和废水安排，处理方案依据实际问题确定。

title.en: Details that help us define the work
title.zh: 帮助我们明确工作的资料

text.en: Send the fixture or area, when the problem occurs, photographs and any known model or previous repair.
text.zh: 提供设备或区域、问题发生时点、照片，以及已知型号或维修经过。

text.en: Include preparation and trading periods, deliveries, access restrictions and the areas that need to remain available.
text.zh: 说明备餐、营业、送货、进场限制，以及需要继续开放的区域。

title.en: A usable handover for the venue

paragraphs.en: We provide a record of completed items, the checks actually carried out and any agreed follow-up. Clean-up is confirmed against the work area, with remaining reopening conditions made clear to your manager.
paragraphs.zh: 我们记录完成项目、实际检查及约定后续工作，按施工区域确认清场，并向负责人明确尚存的重新开放条件。

paragraphs.en: Set protection, drying and clearing times separately for service counter and terrace work.
paragraphs.zh: 按服务台与露台各自受影响区域确定防护、干燥和清场时段。

q.en: Can you work while part of the venue stays open?
q.zh: 部分区域继续营业时可以施工吗？

a.en: We assess whether the work area, customer route and affected services can be separated. The agreed plan identifies the area unavailable and any task that needs a different attendance window.
a.zh: 我们先核对施工区、顾客通道和受影响设施能否分开；约定安排中列明暂停区域，以及需要其他进场窗口的工序。

q.en: Can an outdoor puddle be fixed by cleaning the drain?
q.zh: 户外积水清一下排水口就可以吗？

a.en: We check the surface and accessible drainage route before setting the scope. Debris, a local surface defect and a downstream drainage issue call for different work.
a.zh: 我们先核对地面与可到达的排水路径，再确认范围。积存物、局部地面缺陷和下游排水问题，需要不同处理。

coverAlt.en: Restaurant service counter and dining room
coverAlt.zh: 餐饮场所的服务台与用餐区

strap.zh: 前场 · 后场 · 户外营业

leadTitle.en: Plan each area around its service window.
leadTitle.zh: 分别按营业窗口安排前后场。

caption.en: Pipework at a wet-area work point

note.en: We record the areas available for service, the routes in use and any outstanding drying or cleaning requirement.
note.zh: 我们记录可营业区域、可通行路线及仍需干燥或清洁的事项。

caption.zh: 恢复使用前的餐饮区域

workingExample.en: Map terrace tables, staff paths and shared delivery routes. Record when the surface is available for setting tables again.
workingExample.zh: 标明露台桌位、送餐及共用送货路线，记录恢复摆台时间。

short.en: Coordinate shopfront work with trading hours and loading access.
short.zh: 配合营业时段和装卸进场安排店面维修。

intro.en: Coordinate shopfronts, fittings, signs and common areas with shop operators and centre management. Record completed work by area.
intro.zh: 与店铺经营者和商场管理方协调店面、配件、招牌及公共区域维修，按区域记录完工。

kicker.zh: 店面、租区与公共空间。

deck.en: We coordinate shopfront, tenancy and shared-area repairs with operators and centre management, from a damaged fitting to a staged tenancy refresh.
deck.zh: 我们与经营者及商场管理方协调店面、租区和公共区域维修，涵盖配件处理至分阶段租区更新。

lead.en: The repair location is only one part of a retail maintenance job. We also confirm who approves the work, how materials arrive and which trading routes remain open. This keeps a defined tenancy repair separate from a wider centre-maintenance or make-good scope.
lead.zh: 零售维护除了维修位置，还涉及批准联系人、材料进场和营业通道。我们逐项确认，使租户局部维修、商场维护和退租恢复分别有清晰范围。

metaDescription.en: We coordinate shopfront, tenancy and shared-area repairs with operators and centre management, from a damaged fitting to a staged tenancy refresh.
metaDescription.zh: 我们与经营者及商场管理方协调店面、租区和公共区域维修，涵盖配件处理至分阶段租区更新。

title.en: The details customers use every day

text.en: We review door hardware, tracks, fixed fittings, signs and finishes around the entrance. Operation, visibility and surface matching are considered together.
text.zh: 我们核对入口门五金、轨道、固定配件、标识和饰面，同时确认使用功能、可视性与表面匹配。

text.en: Wall and ceiling damage, lighting faults and fixed joinery are listed by position. Repairs following a water issue include a separate check of the source and affected finish.
text.zh: 墙面吊顶损坏、照明故障和固定木作按位置列项。水相关损坏分别核对源头与受影响饰面。

text.en: Agreed directories, common-area fittings, external surfaces and access points are scoped with centre management and the relevant work boundaries.
text.zh: 约定目录、公共配件、室外表面和出入口，与商场管理方核对后确定工作边界。

paragraphs.en: List the frontage, trading floor, back-of-house and common areas separately. Confirm centre approval for noisy work and loading dock use before combining more than one shop. If a display or fitting stays in place, identify the protection and reinstatement allowance in the scope.
paragraphs.zh: 分别列出店面、营业区、后场和公共区域。合并多间店铺施工前，确认商场批准噪声作业和卸货区使用。展示设施或固定装置保留时，把保护及恢复项目写入范围。

title.en: Three ways to organise the work

rows.en: The item, parts and surrounding finish
Items grouped by tenancy or shared area
rows.zh: 按租区或公共区域分组
管理方批准与分段进场

rows.en: Retain, repair and remove items separately
rows.zh: 分别列明保留、维修与拆除

rows.en: Lease brief, deliveries and handover date
rows.zh: 租赁工作清单、送货与移交日期

title.en: Plan the route into the work
title.zh: 安排材料与人员进场路线

text.en: We identify the nominated operator or manager, the approved work area and any conditions affecting the tenancy or common space.
text.zh: 我们确认经营者或管理方联系人、获批施工区，以及租区或公共空间的相关条件。

text.en: Loading access, lifts, material dimensions, stock protection, temporary separation and waste routes are included where relevant.
text.zh: 按需要安排装卸、货梯、材料尺寸、货品保护、临时分隔和废物路线。

text.en: Connected repairs are completed in the agreed order, with drying or curing conditions reflected in the return-to-use plan.
text.zh: 相关维修按约定顺序完成，并将干燥或固化条件纳入恢复使用安排。

title.en: Check the part and the approved artwork

paragraphs.en: For signage, we confirm the text, artwork, dimensions, position and existing support before manufacturing or replacement is included in the scope. Retaining a frame and replacing a face is a different task from a complete new installation.
paragraphs.zh: 标识工作先核对文字、图稿、尺寸、位置与原支架，再确认制作或更换范围。保留框架换面板，与整套重新安装分别列项。

paragraphs.en: For visible repairs, existing profiles, finishes, paint colours and hardware models help establish a consistent result. Where an exact match is unavailable, we identify the affected area and proposed finish extent before work.
paragraphs.zh: 可见部位维修会核对型材、饰面、油漆颜色和五金型号。无法完全匹配时，我们先明确受影响面积和拟定饰面处理范围。

title.zh: 准备清楚的零售维修需求

text.en: Include the tenancy or area, photographs, the defect history and the contact responsible for approvals.
text.zh: 提供租区或区域、照片、缺陷经过和批准联系人。

text.en: Tell us about trading, centre access, deliveries, retained displays and any date tied to a handover or reopening.
text.zh: 说明营业、商场进场、送货、保留陈列，以及与移交或重新开业有关的日期。

paragraphs.en: Record work and finish checks by tenancy or common area. Match make-good handover to the agreed itemised brief.
paragraphs.zh: 按租区或公共区域记录完工与饰面检查，按约定清单交付退租恢复。

paragraphs.en: Confirm centre approval, stock protection, customer paths, loading dock and goods lift access. Establish when noisy work or temporary closures are possible.
paragraphs.zh: 确认商场批准、商品保护、顾客路线、卸货区及货梯安排，并明确可进行噪声作业或临时封闭的时段。

paragraphs.en: We keep storefront, leased area and centre common area as separate entries, with their own contacts and access windows. Where work moves between a customer-facing area and the loading side, we record the temporary route and the order in which each area can reopen.
paragraphs.zh: 我们分列店面、租区和商场公共区域，对应各自负责人和进场时段。施工如横跨顾客区域与装卸侧，我们会记录临时通行路线和各区恢复使用的顺序。

q.en: Can signs and interior defects be grouped together?
q.zh: 招牌与室内缺陷可以一起安排吗？

a.en: Yes. We can develop one agreed list with separate items for sign content, fabrication or installation, and the building repairs. Access and trade sequencing are then coordinated around that list.
a.zh: 可以。我们可整理一份清单，分别列出标识内容、制作或安装，以及建筑维修，再据此协调进场和工种顺序。

q.en: Can you price from a landlord’s make-good list?
q.zh: 可以按房东的退租清单报价吗？

a.en: Use tenancy condition and retained items to agree finishes, removal and building-service work.
a.zh: 按租区现状和保留项目明确饰面、拆除及设施工作范围。

q.en: Who should approve work at the shopfront?
q.zh: 店面作业应由谁批准？

a.en: Confirm with the tenant and centre manager who controls the affected surface, access route and work hours before the quote is settled.
a.zh: 报价确定前与租户及商场管理方明确谁负责受影响的表面、通道和施工时段。

coverAlt.en: Retail frontage and customer approach
coverAlt.zh: 零售店面与顾客接近路线

strap.zh: 店面 · 租区 · 顾客通行

leadTitle.en: Separate tenancy work from shared routes.
leadTitle.zh: 分清租区与公共通道的工作。

caption.en: Building sign and storefront fixing points
caption.zh: 建筑标识及店面固定点

caption.en: Interior work before returning a tenancy
caption.zh: 租区交还前的室内作业

title.en: Return each area to the operator.

note.en: We check completed work against the agreed tenancy boundary and record any restrictions or make-good items needing another visit.
note.zh: 我们按约定租区边界核对已完工内容，记录仍有限制或需再进场的恢复事项。

workingExample.en: Distinguish the area controlled by the retailer from the centre’s shared frontage and delivery side. Confirm who opens each area and when customer or delivery traffic can use it again.
workingExample.zh: 区分商家管理的店内区域、商场共用店前区域和装卸侧。逐区确认由谁开放，以及顾客或送货人员何时恢复通行。

short.en: Group repairs by floor, tenant area and access window.
short.zh: 按楼层、租区及进场时段归类维修。

intro.en: We arrange repairs and alterations across offices, reception areas, amenities and shared building spaces. We agree the works with the nominated property or tenancy representative, identify services that need to be interrupted and plan around occupied work areas.
intro.zh: 我们安排办公室、接待区、卫生设施及共享空间的维修与改造，向指定物业或租户代表确认范围，列明需要暂停的系统，并配合仍在使用的办公区域。

kicker.zh: 在用楼层，工作明确。

deck.en: We arrange repairs and alterations across offices, reception, amenities and shared building areas, with clear tenant boundaries and access windows.
deck.zh: 我们明确租户边界与进场窗口，安排办公室、接待区、卫生设施和共享区域的维修及改造。

lead.en: An occupied office needs its working areas, meeting rooms and visitor routes considered before attendance. We identify the defects and the people responsible for approvals, then separate local repairs from layout changes, a tenancy refresh or make-good work.
lead.zh: 在用办公室施工前，需要核对工作区、会议室和访客路线。我们确认缺陷及批准联系人，再分别定义局部维修、布局调整、租区更新或退租恢复。

metaDescription.en: We arrange repairs and alterations across offices, reception, amenities and shared building areas, with clear tenant boundaries and access windows.
metaDescription.zh: 我们明确租户边界与进场窗口，安排办公室、接待区、卫生设施和共享区域的维修及改造。

text.en: We scope meeting-room doors, wall damage, ceiling defects, fixed joinery and reception fittings. A water-stained ceiling is considered alongside the relevant source investigation.
text.zh: 我们确认会议室门、墙面损坏、吊顶缺陷、固定木作和接待配件的工作。天花板水渍与相关源头调查一并核对。

text.en: Agreed lighting, air-conditioning and amenity work is listed by the area served. We identify which occupants and shared facilities are affected by any interruption.
text.zh: 约定照明、空调和卫生设施工作，按服务区域列项，并明确暂停时影响的人员和共享设施。

text.en: For local alterations and make-good, we distinguish retained fittings, removals, service coordination and final finishes against the agreed brief.
text.zh: 局部改造与退租恢复按需求清单，分别列明保留配件、拆除、设施协调及最终饰面。

paragraphs.en: Match meeting-room defects, corridor finishes and shared amenities to different release windows. When work crosses several floors, confirm which areas can be isolated and whether a notice must reach staff, visitors or more than one tenant. Identify who has keys and who confirms return to use.
paragraphs.zh: 会议室缺陷、走廊饰面和共用配套设施，各自对应不同交还窗口。跨楼层作业先确定哪些区域可隔离，并确认是否要通知员工、访客或多个租户。明确谁持钥匙、谁确认恢复使用。

title.en: Choose the right scope for the floor

rows.en: Item locations, parts, matching finishes and access
rows.zh: 项目位置、配件、饰面匹配与进场

rows.en: Affected rooms, service interruptions and attendance sequence
rows.zh: 受影响房间、设施停用与进场顺序

rows.en: Approved layout or list, retained items and handover requirements
rows.zh: 已确认布局或清单、保留项目与交付要求

title.en: Arrange the work around occupied areas
title.zh: 结合在用区域安排施工

text.en: We check meeting schedules, staffed areas, visitor access, keys and any building-management conditions affecting the work.
text.zh: 我们核对会议、在岗区域、访客进出、钥匙及楼宇管理条件。

text.en: Material deliveries, lifts, furniture protection, dust and waste movement are planned with the nominated contact.
text.zh: 我们与联系人安排材料送达、电梯、家具保护、粉尘和废物转运。

text.en: We identify the completed rooms or zones and any remaining drying, testing or follow-up condition before normal use resumes.
text.zh: 我们明确已完成房间或区域，以及恢复正常使用前仍需满足的干燥、检查或后续处理条件。

title.en: A coordinated finish across the floor

paragraphs.en: Ceiling tile sizes, partition details, hardware models and paint or laminate finishes are recorded where they affect the repair. We explain whether a local patch, a larger finish area or a replacement part is included.
paragraphs.zh: 当吊顶板尺寸、隔墙细节、五金型号、油漆或饰面板影响维修时，我们会记录并明确局部修补、较大饰面范围或配件更换是否包含。

paragraphs.en: The quote separates investigation, defined repairs and optional changes. Access restrictions, the number of rooms, finish matching and repeated attendance can all change the work package.
paragraphs.zh: 报价区分调查、明确维修和可选改变。进场限制、房间数量、饰面匹配及多次进场，均会影响工作安排。

title.en: What to include in the enquiry

text.en: Mark the floor, room or shared area and describe the problem. Include photographs and any relevant equipment or finish details.
text.zh: 标明楼层、房间或共享区域，描述问题，并附照片及相关设备或饰面资料。

text.en: Identify the tenant or property representative, the available work windows and any move-in or handover date.
text.zh: 明确租户或物业代表、可施工窗口，以及入驻或移交日期。

title.en: Records for tenants and property teams
title.zh: 供租户与物业团队接续的记录

paragraphs.en: List completed work and checks by room or zone. Keep shared-area repairs and tenant work separately traceable.
paragraphs.zh: 按房间或区域记录完工与检查，分别保留公共区和租区维修记录。

paragraphs.en: We mark public, shared and tenant-controlled spaces alongside the booking schedule. This makes it possible to group quiet checks, disruptive work and final cleaning without giving every tenancy the same shutdown or access arrangement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在使用时段表中区分公共、共享和租户管理空间，便于分别安排安静检查、影响使用的工序和最后清洁，各租区按实际需要确定停用或进场时间。

q.en: Can an occupied office be updated in sections?
q.zh: 在用办公室可以分区更新吗？

a.en: We assess the work boundaries, service connections and routes, then agree a sequence by room or zone. Tasks that affect several areas are identified before the staging plan is confirmed.
a.zh: 我们核对施工边界、设施关联和通道，再按房间或区域确认顺序；影响多个区域的工序，会在分期安排前列明。

q.en: Do you need a full design for a small repair list?
q.zh: 小维修清单需要完整设计图吗？

a.en: A clear location list and photographs can start the enquiry. We identify where measurements, equipment details or an approved alteration brief are needed before defining those items.
a.zh: 清楚的位置清单与照片即可开始询价；涉及具体项目时，我们再确认需要补充的测量、设备资料或已批准改造要求。

coverAlt.en: Office workstations and shared workplace
coverAlt.zh: 办公工位与共享办公空间

strap.zh: 房间 · 楼层 · 租户

leadTitle.en: Keep work in step with building use.
leadTitle.zh: 按办公楼使用安排施工。

caption.en: Lighting work at an occupied building fitting

caption.zh: 办公楼入口及建筑饰面

note.en: We note the rooms released and agreed checks, and list any fixture, finish or service that still needs follow-up.
note.zh: 我们注明交还房间及约定检查，并逐项记录仍待跟进的固定装置、饰面或设备。

workingExample.en: Group repairs by the people who use each room. A quick check in a booked meeting room and a disruptive repair beside a shared reception need different access conditions and handback checks.
workingExample.zh: 按房间的使用人群组织维修。已预订会议室里的快速检查，与共享前台旁会影响办公的工序，需要不同的进入条件和交还检查。

short.en: Stage roof, door and paving work around active loading bays.
short.zh: 结合在用装卸区分段安排屋面、门体和铺装工作。

intro.en: We plan building repairs around loading movements, storage areas and the access requirements of your site. We review roof, drainage, lighting and external defects with the manager, then agree work zones and the sequence needed to keep the scope clear.
intro.zh: 我们结合装卸、储存区域和场所通行要求安排建筑维修，与负责人核对屋顶、排水、照明及室外缺陷，再明确施工区域与执行顺序。

kicker.zh: 让施工区域清楚可控。

deck.en: We plan roof, drainage, lighting and building repairs around stock, loading movements and the routes your warehouse needs to use.
deck.zh: 我们围绕存货、装卸和仓库通行路线，安排屋面、排水、照明及建筑维修。

lead.en: A warehouse maintenance scope needs to identify the space below the repair as well as the defect itself. We confirm loading activity, storage areas, pedestrian routes and equipment access, then agree how each work zone is released and returned.
lead.zh: 仓库维修范围既要明确缺陷，也要考虑维修下方的空间。我们核对装卸、储存、人行路线和设备进出，再确认每个施工区如何交出和交还。

metaDescription.en: We plan roof, drainage, lighting and building repairs around stock, loading movements and the routes your warehouse needs to use.
metaDescription.zh: 我们围绕存货、装卸和仓库通行路线，安排屋面、排水、照明及建筑维修。

text.en: We record reported leaks, roof details, box gutters, outlets and downstream drainage. The affected stock or working area is included when planning access and protection.
text.zh: 我们记录漏水、屋面节点、箱形天沟、出水口与下游排水，安排进场和保护时同时考虑受影响货品或作业区。

text.en: Agreed door, cladding, high-level lighting and building defects are identified by location, height and the equipment or space required to reach them.
text.zh: 约定门、围护、高位照明和建筑缺陷，按位置、高度及到达所需设备或空间明确。

text.en: We scope local paving, concrete, drainage and fixed access-item defects with delivery, loading and pedestrian movements in view.
text.zh: 我们结合送货、装卸与行人移动，确认局部铺装、混凝土、排水和固定通行设施的缺陷范围。

paragraphs.en: A leaking roof above stock, a damaged dock door and a failed pavement patch have different impacts. Mark delivery slots and forklift routes together with the affected zone. If a bay closes, agree a replacement route, storage protection and the conditions for vehicles to return.
paragraphs.zh: 存货上方屋面漏水、装卸门损坏和局部铺装破损影响各不相同。把送货时段、叉车路线和受影响区域一起标注。若装卸口停用，约定替代路线、库存保护和车辆恢复条件。

title.zh: 让施工分区对应现场运营

rows.en: Access method, work below, stock protection and weather requirements
rows.zh: 到达方式、下方作业、货品保护与天气要求

rows.en: Vehicle movements, delivery windows and an agreed separated route
rows.zh: 车辆移动、送货窗口与约定分隔路线

rows.en: Extent, substrate, traffic load and material return-to-use conditions
rows.zh: 范围、基层、实际使用荷载与材料恢复使用条件

title.en: Release the area, then run the work
title.zh: 先交出区域，再展开工作

text.en: We agree the affected zone and the nominated site contact. Vehicle, forklift and pedestrian activity is discussed alongside the proposed work.
text.zh: 我们确认受影响区域和现场联系人，将车辆、叉车与行人活动一并纳入施工安排。

text.en: We identify equipment space, deliveries, storage protection and any service interruption. Connected repairs are ordered before final finishes.
text.zh: 我们明确设备空间、材料送达、货品保护及设施暂停，并在最终饰面前安排关联维修。

text.en: We record the completed scope and the conditions for reopening. Any further investigation, parts or follow-up remain separate from completed work.
text.zh: 我们记录完成范围和重新开放条件，将进一步调查、配件或后续处理与已完成工作分别列明。

title.en: One defect or a planned zone of work
title.zh: 单个缺陷与计划分区工作

paragraphs.en: Price single fittings after checking condition and access. Review recurring roof, drain or surface defects together and plan by zone.
paragraphs.zh: 核对现状和进场后列出局部维修报价。反复屋面、排水或地面问题集中检查并分区安排。

paragraphs.en: Materials, installation height, the condition below the surface, equipment access and operating restrictions influence the work package. We identify investigation separately where the cause is concealed.
paragraphs.zh: 材料、安装高度、表层以下状况、设备进出和运营限制，都会影响工作包；原因隐蔽时，调查范围单独确认。

title.en: Send the defect with its operating context
title.zh: 描述缺陷，也说明使用条件

text.en: Include a site or bay reference, the fault pattern, photographs and any previous repair records.
text.zh: 提供场地或仓位编号、故障规律、照片和既有维修记录。

text.en: Identify loading periods, routes, stock that needs protection and available inspection or attendance windows.
text.zh: 说明装卸时段、路线、需保护货品，以及检查或施工窗口。

title.zh: 留下可接续的物业记录

paragraphs.en: We tie completion photographs and notes to the defined zone and repaired item. Where the problem depends on rainfall or operating conditions, any agreed follow-up observation is recorded with the original history.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将完工照片和说明对应到施工区与修复项目。问题与降雨或运营条件有关时，约定的后续观察会与原始经过一同保留。

paragraphs.en: We record which bays are active, which doors form part of vehicle routes and where stock can be moved. A surface repair near a dock requires an agreed protection plan and a release point that warehouse staff can verify before resuming movements.
paragraphs.zh: 我们记录正在使用的装卸位、车辆路线上的门口和可腾挪存货的区域。码头附近的表面维修要确认现场防护与通行恢复条件，再由仓库人员核对后恢复使用。

q.en: Can roof work happen while stock remains below?
q.zh: 屋面施工时下方货物可以保留吗？

a.en: Check the work area and the space below. Include stock protection and zone release conditions in the brief.
a.zh: 检查作业区及下方区域，在清单中列明货品保护和分区交还条件。

q.en: Can we repair only part of a loading area?
q.zh: 可以只修装卸区的一部分吗？

a.en: We define the defect, substrate and route arrangements before agreeing a local repair. Material curing and the intended traffic use determine the conditions for returning that section to service.
a.zh: 我们先确认缺陷、基层和路线安排，再确定局部维修；该区域恢复使用的条件依据材料固化和实际车辆使用要求确认。

q.en: Can a loading bay stay open during repairs?
q.zh: 维修期间可继续使用装卸区吗？

a.en: Confirm the separation from work, vehicle clearances and traffic arrangements first. Some work requires temporary closure and an alternative bay.
a.zh: 先确认作业隔离、车辆净空及交通安排。部分工作需要暂时封闭并启用替代装卸区。

coverAlt.en: Truck and warehouse loading dock
coverAlt.zh: 货车与仓库装卸口

strap.zh: 装卸 · 存货 · 车辆路线

leadTitle.en: Stage the work around live loading.
leadTitle.zh: 结合在用装卸口分段作业。

caption.zh: 仓库外部与车辆接近路线

caption.en: Marked vehicle and pedestrian circulation surface

title.en: Release bays one stage at a time.

note.en: We identify usable bays, remaining restrictions and observations after rain or traffic where agreed.
note.zh: 我们标明可用装卸区、剩余限制，以及约定在下雨或通车后观察的事项。

caption.en: Building equipment in a commercial facility

workingExample.en: A damaged threshold at an active bay affects loading as well as the building. Record the vehicle route, available alternate bay and the check the warehouse team needs before reopening the lane.
workingExample.zh: 在用装卸位的门槛破损同时影响建筑与装卸。记录车辆路线、可替代的装卸位，以及仓库团队重新开放通道前需要的检查。

short.en: Plan property repairs around work bays and production schedules.
short.zh: 配合作业工位和生产时段安排物业维修。

intro.en: We scope building maintenance around your operating areas, site induction and equipment movements. We focus on the agreed building, services and external works, identify shutdown or access needs and record the completed repairs for your property team.
intro.zh: 我们结合生产作业区、现场进场要求和设备移动安排建筑维护，明确建筑、设施及室外工程范围，核对停用或通行需求，并为物业团队记录完工内容。

kicker.zh: 建筑维护，衔接现场作业。

deck.en: We define building, amenity and external repairs around work areas, site access and the operating conditions of your workshop or industrial property.
deck.zh: 我们结合工场或工业物业的作业区域、进场及运营条件，明确建筑、卫生设施和室外维修范围。

lead.en: We organise maintenance of the premises around the way the site is used. Roof and cladding faults, doors, agreed lighting and plumbing, and external surfaces are identified separately from production equipment. Your site contact helps define access, interruptions and the sequence for each area.
lead.zh: 我们围绕场所使用方式安排物业维护，将屋面围护、门、约定照明水管和室外地面，与生产设备分别界定；通过现场联系人确认各区域进场、停用和施工顺序。

metaDescription.en: We define building, amenity and external repairs around work areas, site access and the operating conditions of your workshop or industrial property.
metaDescription.zh: 我们结合工场或工业物业的作业区域、进场及运营条件，明确建筑、卫生设施和室外维修范围。

title.en: The building and the spaces around it

text.en: We scope leaks, visible building damage and door defects with attention to the work below or alongside the repair. Existing materials and fixing details are checked before replacement is defined.
text.zh: 我们确认漏水、可见建筑损坏和门缺陷，并考虑维修下方或邻近的作业；确定更换前核对现有材料和固定细节。

text.en: Plumbing, lighting and service-area maintenance is defined by the affected fixture or zone. Any interruption and restoration check is included in the plan.
text.zh: 水管、照明和后勤区域维护按受影响设施或区域划分，并明确暂停与恢复检查。

text.en: We record external surface defects, drainage points and fixed access items alongside traffic, deliveries and material movement.
text.zh: 我们结合交通、送货和材料搬运，记录室外地面缺陷、排水点和固定通行设施。

paragraphs.en: Map pedestrian and forklift routes at the boundary of building and production work. Agree access, separation and release by bay.
paragraphs.zh: 在建筑作业与生产区交界标明人行及叉车路线，逐工位确认进场、隔离和交还安排。

rows.en: Location, condition, equipment nearby and available access
rows.zh: 位置、现状、附近设备与可进场条件

rows.en: Related defects, repeat materials and zones available together
rows.zh: 关联缺陷、重复材料及可同时交出区域

rows.en: Extent, service effects, staged release and reinstatement requirements
rows.zh: 范围、设施影响、分阶段交出与恢复要求

title.en: Connect the work with the site schedule

text.en: We confirm the nominated contact, induction or access requirements, nearby activity and the boundaries of the building work.
text.zh: 我们确认联系人、现场介绍或进场要求、附近作业，以及建筑工作的边界。

text.en: Vehicle and pedestrian movement, material deliveries, equipment access and any agreed service isolation are planned with the site team.
text.zh: 我们与现场团队安排车辆与行人、材料送达、设备进出和约定设施停用。

text.en: The record identifies completed repairs, the checks performed and any material requirement or outstanding item affecting return to use.
text.zh: 记录列明完成维修、实际检查，以及影响恢复使用的材料要求或未完项目。

paragraphs.en: We check the surface, substrate, exposure and retained components before defining materials or repair extent. A visible floor or cladding defect can need investigation of the supporting condition before a local repair is finalised.
paragraphs.zh: 我们先核对表面、基层、暴露条件和保留构件，再确定材料与修复范围；地面或围护的可见缺陷，有时需确认支承或基层现状后才能决定局部修复。

paragraphs.en: Installation height, work-zone availability, equipment access, waste and staged attendance influence the quote. We show investigation and additional findings separately rather than absorbing an unknown condition into a vague allowance.
paragraphs.zh: 安装高度、区域可用性、设备进场、废物和分段施工会影响报价；调查与额外发现会单独列项，便于确认具体范围。

title.zh: 提供物业设施的工作需求

text.en: Send the building area, problem history, photographs and any relevant material or equipment information.
text.zh: 提供建筑区域、问题经过、照片和相关材料或设备资料。

text.en: Include who controls access, routes that must remain available and any planned interruption window.
text.zh: 说明进场负责人、需保持开放的路线及计划停用窗口。

title.en: Completion tied to the agreed zone

paragraphs.en: We document the building work completed and any follow-up decision. The handover keeps each repair connected to its location, avoiding confusion between property maintenance and separate production-equipment tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们记录已完成建筑工作与后续决定，让每项维修对应位置，并清楚区分物业维护与另行安排的生产设备工作。

paragraphs.en: Send photos and a site sketch, traffic routes, hot or noisy work restrictions, contact details and any required induction information.
paragraphs.zh: 提供照片与场地图，说明交通路线、热作或噪声限制、联系人及需要的入场说明。

paragraphs.en: We identify where building maintenance meets production equipment or a controlled work zone. The property brief records which work can happen beside normal operations, which area needs to be cleared and who confirms that production-side interfaces are ready.
paragraphs.zh: 我们标出建筑维修与生产设备或受控作业区的交界。在清单中记录哪些工作可配合正常作业开展、哪些区域需要清空，以及由谁确认与生产有关的接口条件。

q.en: Does this include production machinery repairs?
q.zh: 这是否包括生产机械维修？

a.en: This page covers the agreed building, services and external-property work. We define that scope with your site contact and keep production-equipment requirements separate.
a.zh: 本页范围为已确认的建筑、设施及室外物业工作；我们与现场联系人明确这些项目，并将生产设备需求另行区分。

q.en: Can we group work into a planned shutdown?
q.zh: 可以集中在计划停用期间施工吗？

a.en: We can review the proposed list against the available window, materials and access. The agreed sequence identifies tasks that can be completed within that period and any necessary follow-up attendance.
a.zh: 可以结合可用窗口、材料和进场条件核对清单；约定顺序中列明该时段可完成的工作及需要再次进场的项目。

coverAlt.zh: 设有设备和作业通道的工业车间

leadTitle.en: Fit the property work around the production plan.
leadTitle.zh: 配合生产安排物业维修。

caption.en: Plant and access on a roof

title.en: Hand back each work bay with clear boundaries.

note.en: We identify building items checked and conditions the operator must confirm before reopening the affected area.
note.zh: 我们标明已检查的建筑设施，以及经营方重新启用区域前需确认的条件。

workingExample.en: Where the work meets a production area, identify which equipment and routes are controlled by the site team. Agree the scope and who confirms the affected section can return to use.
workingExample.zh: 维修接近生产区域时，标记由现场团队管理的设备和通行路线。确认维修范围，以及由谁确认受影响分区可恢复使用。

short.en: Schedule property repairs around classes, appointments and bookings.
short.zh: 避开课程、诊疗预约和社区活动安排维修。

intro.en: We coordinate maintenance with the nominated facility manager and the site's operating requirements. We confirm occupied areas, access restrictions, cleaning needs and the agreed work before attendance, with particular attention to keeping work zones separate from everyday use.
intro.zh: 我们与指定设施负责人按场所运营要求协调维护，进场前确认使用区域、通行限制、清洁要求及工作范围，并重点安排施工区域与日常使用空间的分隔。

kicker.en: EVERY ROOM HAS A DIFFERENT DAY.
kicker.zh: 每个空间，都有使用节奏。

deck.en: We coordinate room, amenity, access and grounds maintenance with your facility manager, using defined work zones and a clear return-to-use plan.
deck.zh: 我们与设施负责人协调房间、卫生设施、通行及园林维护，明确施工分区和恢复使用安排。

lead.en: A classroom, consultation space and community hall have different occupancy patterns. We use the facility’s operating requirements to plan access and separation, then confirm the building work, affected services and cleaning needed for the agreed area.
lead.zh: 教室、咨询空间和社区活动厅的使用规律不同。我们根据设施运营要求安排进场与分隔，再确认建筑工作、受影响设施和约定区域的清洁要求。

metaDescription.en: We coordinate room, amenity, access and grounds maintenance with your facility manager, using defined work zones and a clear return-to-use plan.
metaDescription.zh: 我们与设施负责人协调房间、卫生设施、通行及园林维护，明确施工分区和恢复使用安排。

title.zh: 三类场所，各有进场安排

rows.en: Class use, arrival and collection periods, occupied rooms and available holiday windows
rows.zh: 教学使用、接送时段、在用房间及可用假期窗口

rows.en: Reception and room use, nominated access, separation and the facility’s cleaning requirements
rows.zh: 接待与房间使用、指定进场、分隔及设施清洁要求

rows.en: Bookings, events, public routes and the area available between uses
rows.zh: 预订、活动、公共路线及使用间隙可交出区域

title.en: Practical work across rooms and grounds
title.zh: 房间与场地的具体工作

text.en: We scope doors, hardware, walls, ceilings, fixed fittings and agreed amenity repairs by room or location.
text.zh: 我们按房间或位置确认门、五金、墙面、吊顶、固定配件和约定卫生设施维修。

text.en: Lighting and access-related work is checked against the existing equipment and the spaces affected. Any service interruption is identified before attendance.
text.zh: 照明与门禁相关工作结合现有设备和受影响空间核对，进场前明确设施暂停影响。

text.en: Grounds, pathways, gardens and agreed external fixtures are reviewed with public movement and material access in mind.
text.zh: 园林、步道、花园和约定室外设施，同时考虑公众通行及材料进场。

paragraphs.en: A classroom repair needs a teaching gap, clinic waiting-area work needs appointment and hygiene coordination, and a hall repair depends on bookings. Record the alternate accessible route and the staff member who can release the space back to use. Keep medical equipment and other specialist systems out of the property scope.
paragraphs.zh: 教室维修需要避开教学，候诊区工作要协调预约与卫生要求，社区大厅则按预订时段安排。记录替代无障碍通道及确认重新开放的工作人员。医疗设备和其他专业系统与物业范围分开。

paragraphs.en: A single door fault or damaged wall can be defined as a local task. A longer room or grounds list can be grouped into stages, keeping each item and its access requirements visible.
paragraphs.zh: 单个门故障或墙面损坏，可明确为局部任务；较长的房间或场地清单，可以分阶段安排，同时保留每项工作与进场要求。

paragraphs.en: For a larger update, we confirm retained items, materials, affected services and the sequence before finishes and clean-up. Specialist operational requirements are supplied by the facility and incorporated into the agreed building-work plan.
paragraphs.zh: 较大更新会先核对保留项目、材料、受影响设施和工序，再安排饰面及清场。设施方提供其专门运营要求，我们将其纳入约定建筑施工安排。

title.en: Define the work zone before arrival

text.en: We confirm the nominated facility representative, approved area, access restrictions and who can make decisions about changes.
text.zh: 我们确认设施代表、批准区域、进场限制和额外工作决定人。

text.en: Material delivery, protection, noise, dust, waste routes and any temporary access changes are planned for the specific setting.
text.zh: 材料送达、保护、噪声、粉尘、废物路线及临时通行变化，按具体场所安排。

text.en: We record finished tasks, relevant operation checks, cleaning and any remaining conditions affecting reopening.
text.zh: 我们记录完成任务、相关功能检查、清场和仍影响重新开放的条件。

title.en: Start with the room or grounds list
title.zh: 从房间或场地清单开始

text.en: Provide room names or site references, photographs, the symptom and known equipment or finish details.
text.zh: 提供房间名称或场地编号、照片、问题表现，以及已知设备或饰面资料。

text.en: Include operating hours, bookings, access arrangements and any facility-specific work or cleaning requirements.
text.zh: 说明运营时间、预订、进场安排和设施自身的施工或清洁要求。

title.en: A handover the facility can follow

paragraphs.en: Record completed work, material orders, follow-up visits and reopening checks by location.
paragraphs.zh: 按位置记录完工、材料订货、后续进场与开放前检查。

paragraphs.en: We record the room use, the next session or appointment and the entrance people must keep using. The work list separates function checks from cleaning and reopening, so the contact on duty can verify when the room is suitable to receive people again.
paragraphs.zh: 我们记录房间用途、下一场活动或预约，以及必须保持开放的入口。工作清单分列功能检查、清洁和重新开放，便于值班人员核对何时可以恢复接待。

q.en: Can you group maintenance into a holiday or booking gap?
q.zh: 可以集中在假期或预订空档维护吗？

a.en: We review the work list against access, materials and the available period. Tasks requiring curing, a service interruption or a return visit are identified before the sequence is agreed.
a.zh: 我们结合进场、材料和可用时段核对清单；需要固化、设施停用或再次进场的任务，会在确认工序前列明。

q.en: What does healthcare maintenance cover here?
q.zh: 这里的医疗场所维护包括什么？

a.en: We scope the agreed building and facility items such as rooms, doors, finishes, amenities and access. The facility supplies its operating and cleaning requirements for those work areas.
a.zh: 我们确认房间、门、饰面、卫生设施和通行等建筑与物业项目；设施方提供这些施工区的运营与清洁要求。

coverAlt.zh: 诊所前台与候诊区

leadTitle.en: Schedule work around the people using the space.
leadTitle.zh: 结合使用人群安排工作时段。

caption.en: Door entry reader and user access
caption.zh: 入口读卡设备及人员通行

caption.en: Hard floor cleaning before public use
caption.zh: 公众使用前的硬质地面清洁

title.en: Reopen rooms only after agreed checks.
title.zh: 按约定检查后交还房间。

note.en: We record completed rooms, cleaned areas, restrictions and the person told about release.
note.zh: 我们记录已完成房间、已清洁区域、剩余限制及接收交还通知的人员。

caption.en: Shared indoor finishes to check at handback
caption.zh: 交还前核对的公共室内饰面

workingExample.en: At a clinic, a room can be made available between appointments while the main entry stays in use. Record the room, allowed access, protected circulation and who checks cleaning and reopens it. For classrooms or halls, use the next lesson or booking as the equivalent handback point.
workingExample.zh: 以诊所为例，维修可在两次预约之间进入指定房间，主入口仍需正常通行。把房间、进场时段、需保护的路线及清洁复核负责人写进同一份安排。教室与活动厅则分别以下一堂课或下一场预订为交还节点。

title.en: Salt air and coastal building maintenance
title.zh: 海盐环境下的商业建筑维护

summary.en: How we scope cleaning and repairs on exposed and sheltered building surfaces.
summary.zh: 我们如何核对外露与遮蔽建筑表面的清洁及维修范围。

title.en: Record the exposure at each location

paragraphs.en: We look at the face of the building, overhangs, sheltered ledges, door tops and accessible fixings. Photographs show the item and the area around it, allowing later observations to be compared with the same location. The record also identifies the material or product where it is known.
paragraphs.zh: 我们核对建筑朝向、挑檐、遮蔽平台、门顶和可到达固定件。照片同时保留部件与周边，便于日后对应同一位置比较，并记录已知材料或产品。

paragraphs.en: COLORBOND maintenance guidance distinguishes rain-washed surfaces from areas that rain does not wash effectively, and addresses marine salt exposure. We apply the instructions for the installed product. Other metals, coatings, glass and hardware need their own care requirements checked.
paragraphs.zh: COLORBOND 维护资料区分雨水能有效冲洗和难以冲洗的表面，并说明海盐暴露条件。我们采用现场对应产品的要求；其他金属、涂层、玻璃和五金分别核对适用维护资料。

paragraphs.en: Compare rain-washed and sheltered surfaces. Clean deposits on intact coatings with a compatible method. Separately inspect bubbling, exposed metal and recurrent fixing damage.
paragraphs.zh: 对照雨淋面和遮蔽面。完整涂层的沉积物采用相容方式清洁，单独检查起泡、露出金属及反复损伤的固定点。

rows.en: Material, finish and a suitable cleaning method
rows.zh: 材料、饰面与适用清洁方法

rows.en: Extent, adjacent details and condition beneath the finish
rows.zh: 范围、相邻细节与饰面下方状况

rows.en: The door or window, frame, alignment and related parts
rows.zh: 门窗、框、对位及关联配件

rows.en: Adjustment, part repair or replacement as confirmed
rows.zh: 按确认情况调整、维修或更换

title.en: Cleaning, repair and replacement have different jobs
title.zh: 清洁、维修与更换各有作用

text.en: We agree the surface, product-compatible method, access and protection. Cleaning can reveal the condition more clearly; it does not restore a failed coating or a damaged component by itself.
text.zh: 我们确认表面、与产品适配的方法、进场和保护。清洁可帮助显现材料状况；已失效涂层或损坏构件还需分别确认修复。

text.en: A local repair needs an identified defect, sound surrounding material and a workable finish detail. We record the area to be prepared and any matching limitation.
text.zh: 局部修复需明确缺陷、周边材料状况及可执行饰面细节，并记录基层准备范围与材料匹配条件。

title.en: Replace where the scope requires it

text.en: Replacement is considered against the component condition, compatibility and intended operation. Adjacent fixings, interfaces and finishes are included when they affect the result.
text.zh: 更换结合部件状况、兼容性和使用功能确定；影响结果的相邻固定件、衔接部位与饰面一并纳入。

paragraphs.en: Compare a rain-washed surface with a sheltered fixing on the same elevation. A surface deposit, a failing finish and a stiff opening tell us different things. Keeping separate observations makes it easier to agree cleaning, a local repair or a closer inspection.
paragraphs.zh: 比较同一立面上受雨水冲洗的表面与遮蔽处的固定件。表面沉积、饰层失效和门窗发涩代表不同问题，分开记录后，才容易确定清洁、局部修理或进一步检查的范围。

title.en: Check the complete door or window

paragraphs.en: Inspect alignment, hinges, frame, latch and moving parts as an assembly before defining a repair.
paragraphs.zh: 把对位、铰链、门框、锁舌及活动部件作为一套核对后确定维修。

paragraphs.en: Existing model details and photographs help us check replacement compatibility. We keep part selection, surface treatment and any broader door or frame work separate in the quotation.
paragraphs.zh: 现有型号与照片有助于核对替换兼容性。配件选择、表面处理及较大门体或框体工作，会在报价中分别列明。

text.en: We identify guest or customer routes, neighbouring glazing, landscaped areas and any equipment needed to reach the work.
text.zh: 我们明确住客或顾客路线、邻近玻璃、绿化区域及到达施工部位所需设备。

text.en: Wash-water handling is part of the method. Gold Coast pollution guidance addresses cleaning runoff; we identify the site arrangements before washing begins.
text.zh: 清洗废水处理属于施工方法的一部分。黄金海岸污染指引涉及清洁径流；我们在清洗前确认现场安排。

text.en: Roof, façade, door and external-area items can be grouped for access while retaining separate materials and completion checks.
text.zh: 屋面、立面、门和室外项目可以结合进场归并安排，同时保留各自材料与完成检查。

title.en: Build the next visit from the record
title.zh: 用本次记录安排后续维护

paragraphs.en: We use product instructions, the observed condition and actual exposure to define the next maintenance scope. The same fixed interval is not applied to every component. A location record makes it easier to see whether the deposit or deterioration has changed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们结合产品要求、观察到的状况和实际暴露环境定义后续维护，分别确定不同构件的安排。位置记录有助于识别积存或损耗是否发生变化。

paragraphs.en: Keep cleaned areas, repairs, replacement parts and follow-up visits together with photographs and material records.
paragraphs.zh: 将清洁区域、维修、更换配件与后续进场同照片及材料资料一并记录。

kicker.zh: 海岸维护笔记／材料

deck.en: We map exposure, material condition and access before separating coastal cleaning, local repairs and replacement work.
deck.zh: 我们先梳理暴露环境、材料现状与进场条件，再区分沿海清洁、局部维修和更换工作。

lead.en: Coastal maintenance starts with a location-specific record. A sheltered door, an exposed fixing and a rain-washed wall do not present the same conditions. We document the installed material, visible change and surrounding detail, then build a scope that distinguishes deposits, deterioration and operating faults.
lead.zh: 沿海维护从具体位置记录开始。遮蔽处的门、外露固定件与雨水能冲洗的墙面，所处条件并不相同。我们记录安装材料、可见变化及周边细节，再将积存物、材料损耗和功能故障分别纳入工作范围。

metaDescription.en: We map exposure, material condition and access before separating coastal cleaning, local repairs and replacement work.
metaDescription.zh: 我们先梳理暴露环境、材料现状与进场条件，再区分沿海清洁、局部维修和更换工作。

q.en: Does a coastal property need one maintenance interval for everything?
q.zh: 沿海物业所有部位都按同一周期维护吗？

a.en: Set site-specific cleaning and review schedules for sheltered metal, moving hardware and drainage points.
a.zh: 按产品、暴露和使用情况为遮蔽金属、活动五金及排水点分别安排清洁与复查。

q.en: Should a stained metal surface be repainted immediately?
q.zh: 金属表面出现污渍就应马上重涂吗？

a.en: We first identify the material and visible condition. Deposits, coating failure and underlying deterioration require different preparation and treatment, so the repainting extent follows that assessment.
a.zh: 我们先核对材料和可见状况。积存物、涂层失效与下方材料损耗，对准备和处理要求不同，重涂范围据此确定。

coverAlt.zh: 沿海建筑的阳台与外部门窗

leadTitle.en: Read the exposure before choosing a repair.
leadTitle.zh: 判断暴露条件，再决定处理方式。

caption.en: Profile and joints of an aluminium frame
caption.zh: 铝合金框体与连接部位

title.zh: 把现场观察整理成清单。

note.en: Send one wide photograph per elevation and close-ups of joints or fixings. Include the material or coating if known and which areas are usually sheltered from rain.
note.zh: 每面立面提供一张全景，并拍摄节点或固定件近照。注明已知材料或涂层，以及平时难被雨水冲洗的位置。

takeaway.en: Read the surface and the moving parts separately.
takeaway.zh: 表面变化和开关不顺，要分开查。

caption.en: Sheltered metal cladding and roof edge
caption.zh: 遮蔽处的金属覆层和屋面边缘

caption.en: Exposed door hardware and worn finish
caption.zh: 外露门五金与磨损饰面

workingExample.en: Compare a sheltered door fitting with a nearby exposed surface. If the fitting is stiff and the finish only shows deposits, record both separately before deciding whether cleaning, adjustment or closer inspection is appropriate.
workingExample.zh: 把遮蔽处的门五金与旁边露天饰面分别检查。五金发涩而饰面只是附着沉积物时，先分开记录，再决定清洁、调整或进一步检查。

title.en: Preparing commercial roofs and gutters for storm season
title.zh: 暴雨季前的商业屋顶与天沟维护

summary.en: A practical scope for roof defects, outlets and the path rainwater takes.
summary.zh: 从屋面缺陷、出水口到雨水路径明确维护范围。

title.en: Start with the history of the problem

paragraphs.en: Record location, weather, timing and duration, and match affected rooms, bays or elevations to the external drainage routes.
paragraphs.zh: 记录位置、天气、出现时间及持续时长，将受影响的房间、仓位或立面与外部排水路径对应。

paragraphs.en: Photographs of an earlier patch, replaced outlet or water-stained ceiling are valuable context. We keep the history with the defect record so that the next attendance does not begin with an isolated description of “a roof leak”.
paragraphs.zh: 既有补漏、更换出水口或水渍吊顶的照片，是有用背景。我们将经过与缺陷记录一起保留，使下次进场能够针对具体部位接续核对。

paragraphs.en: Check blocked outlets even when roof sheets are intact. Record where water first appears and reaches the ground; scope clearing, joint repairs and downstream work separately.
paragraphs.zh: 屋面板完好也要检查出水口堵塞。记录最先出水点及水到达地面的位置，分列清理、接头维修及下游排水工作。

title.en: Follow the route from roof to ground
title.zh: 沿屋面到地面的水路核对

text.en: We assess relevant sheets, flashings, penetrations and visible junctions against the reported symptoms. An issue beside rooftop equipment needs its surrounding detail considered.
text.zh: 我们结合现象核对相关屋面板、泛水、穿屋面节点和可见衔接处；屋顶设备旁的问题会连同周边节点检查。

text.en: We distinguish debris and accessible outlet restrictions from damaged gutter sections, joints or associated components. The condition and access determine the work scope.
text.zh: 我们区分积存物、可到达出水口受阻，以及天沟段、接缝或相关构件损坏；工作范围依据现状和进场条件确定。

text.en: The receiving downpipe and accessible drainage route are considered where the report indicates a downstream issue. Roof cleaning and a ground-level drainage repair remain separate tasks.
text.zh: 现象涉及下游时，我们核对承接落水管和可到达排水路径；屋面清理与地面排水修复分别列项。

paragraphs.en: Compare an indoor mark’s timing and position with wind and rain, then map roof falls, gutter outlets and obstructions.
paragraphs.zh: 把室内水迹的位置和时点与风雨对照，标记屋面坡向、天沟出水口和沿途障碍。

rows.en: Debris at a gutter or outlet
Extent, accessibility and the condition exposed after clearing
rows.zh: 范围、可达性及清理后显现状况

rows.en: Leak near a joint or penetration
rows.zh: 接缝或穿屋面处附近漏水

rows.en: The relevant detail and adjacent water route
Defined detail repair or further investigation
rows.zh: 明确节点修复或进一步调查

rows.en: Repeated overflow or multiple affected areas
rows.zh: 反复溢流或多处受影响
关联出水口与下游情况

paragraphs.en: Clearing debris restores access to the surface and outlet being cleaned. If joints, fixings or lining are damaged, the repair needs its own material and preparation detail. We identify whether the work is a local repair, replacement of a defined section or a larger scope supported by the inspection.
paragraphs.zh: 清理积屑针对需要清洁的表面与出水口。接缝、固定件或衬层受损时，维修需另行明确材料及基层准备；我们根据检查区分局部修复、明确区段更换或较大范围。

paragraphs.en: Existing material compatibility, the extent exposed and any work beneath the surface influence the proposed method. A waterproofing repair also needs the installed system and substrate considered; a coating or sealant name alone does not define a complete repair.
paragraphs.zh: 现有材料兼容、已显现范围和表层以下工作，会影响方法。防水修复还需核对既有系统与基层，完整范围包括衔接和准备细节。

title.en: Plan for the building in use

text.en: We identify roof access, the occupied area below and any stock, equipment or finishes needing protection.
text.zh: 我们确认屋面到达方式、下方在用区域，以及需保护的货品、设备或饰面。

title.zh: 确认受天气影响的工序

text.en: The City of Gold Coast identifies severe-weather risks including heavy rain and damaging winds. We agree suitable attendance and material conditions for the specific work.
text.zh: 黄金海岸官方资料列有强降雨和破坏性风等天气风险。我们根据具体工作确认适用进场及材料施工条件。

text.en: Any investigation, additional parts or observation linked to the original leak conditions is identified separately from the completed repair.
text.zh: 调查、追加配件或与原漏水条件有关的观察，均与已完成维修分别记录。

title.en: Keep a roof record that supports the next decision
title.zh: 保留支持后续决定的屋面记录

paragraphs.en: Our completion record identifies the areas inspected, material removed, details repaired and checks actually carried out. It also records inaccessible areas or unresolved questions that need another agreed action.
paragraphs.zh: 完工记录列明检查区域、清理物、修复节点和实际进行的检查，并保留未能到达区域或需要另行安排的问题。

paragraphs.en: Where interior finishes are affected, their repair is sequenced with the source work and the condition of the substrate. This keeps a ceiling repaint from being treated as the whole response to an unresolved water problem.
paragraphs.zh: 室内饰面受影响时，其修复顺序结合源头处理和基层状况确定，让水问题与表面恢复分别得到落实。

kicker.zh: 海岸维护笔记／屋面与排水

deck.en: We connect previous leak reports with roof details, gutters, outlets and downstream drainage, then separate cleaning, repairs and investigation.
deck.zh: 我们将既有漏水记录与屋面节点、天沟、出水口及下游排水相连，再区分清理、维修和调查工作。

lead.en: Rain-related maintenance works best when the roof and the route below it are recorded together. We start with previous symptoms, the areas affected and the repairs already attempted. That history helps define what needs inspection, what can be scoped directly and what still needs investigation.
lead.zh: 雨水相关维护需要把屋面与下游路径一同记录。我们从既有现象、受影响区域和尝试过的维修入手，区分需要检查、能够直接明确，以及仍需调查的工作。

metaDescription.en: We connect previous leak reports with roof details, gutters, outlets and downstream drainage, then separate cleaning, repairs and investigation.
metaDescription.zh: 我们将既有漏水记录与屋面节点、天沟、出水口及下游排水相连，再区分清理、维修和调查工作。

q.en: Is clearing the gutters enough when a building has leaked before?
q.zh: 建筑以前漏过水，只清天沟够吗？

a.en: Review the leak history and list affected outlets, joints, roof details and downstream drains as separate work items.
a.zh: 核对漏水经过，分列受影响的出水口、接缝、屋面节点及下游排水项目。

q.en: Can roof repairs and ceiling repairs be arranged together?
q.zh: 屋面维修和吊顶修复能一起安排吗？

a.en: We can coordinate both scopes, with source investigation and treatment sequenced before the affected finish is reinstated. The ceiling material and its actual condition determine the restoration extent.
a.zh: 可以协调两类范围，先安排源头调查与处理，再结合受影响材料的实际状况确定吊顶恢复范围。

detailTitle.zh: 商业屋面与天沟：强降雨前怎样安排维护

coverAlt.en: Commercial warehouse roof and frontage
coverAlt.zh: 商业仓库屋面与外部通道

strap.zh: 屋面 · 天沟 · 地面排水

leadTitle.en: Follow the route water actually takes.
leadTitle.zh: 沿实际水路逐段核对。

caption.en: Roof edges and external drainage path
caption.zh: 屋面边缘及室外排水路径

title.en: Bring the roof history into the next visit.
title.zh: 把以往降雨记录带入下次维护。

note.en: Mark affected roof and ground locations and the indoor areas requiring protection. Keep suspected faults distinct from completed checks.
note.zh: 标注受影响的屋面与地面位置，以及需要保护的室内区域。将疑似故障和已完成检查分开记录。

takeaway.en: Follow the water route before deciding where to repair.
takeaway.zh: 先追排水路径，再定维修位置。

caption.en: Interior marks to log alongside rainfall
caption.zh: 需与降雨一并记录的室内水迹

caption.en: Junctions between walls, glazing and roof details
caption.zh: 墙面、玻璃与屋面细部交界

workingExample.en: An indoor stain and the closest outlet are two useful observations, but also record what happened upstream. The route from roof to outlet to ground can explain why the mark appears only in certain storms.
workingExample.zh: 室内水迹与最近的出水口都是有用线索，也要记录上游情况。沿屋面、出水口到地面追查，才能判断水迹为何只在某些暴雨中出现。

title.en: Planning hotel maintenance between guest stays
title.zh: 配合住客入住安排酒店维护

summary.en: How we turn a room-access window into a clear maintenance plan.
summary.zh: 我们如何把房间可进场时间转化为明确的维护安排。

title.en: Build a room list with enough detail
title.zh: 把客房清单写到可以安排

paragraphs.en: Record room or area, visible signs, photographs, material details, recurrence, previous repairs and affected facilities.
paragraphs.zh: 记录房号或公共区、问题表现、照片、材料资料、复发情况、历次维修及受影响设施。

paragraphs.en: Group repeated defects while keeping room numbers. Check hardware models and distinguish surface marks from plasterboard damage before ordering parts and scheduling work.
paragraphs.zh: 归并重复缺陷并保留房号。订货排期前核对五金型号，区分饰面痕迹与石膏板损伤。

paragraphs.en: Use a vacancy for definite tasks such as an identified hardware adjustment. Keep a room on hold when the finish needs to dry or a leak is still being investigated. For shared corridors, plan a guest route, noise window and cleaning check separately from the accommodation schedule.
paragraphs.zh: 明确的五金调整可以利用空房时段。饰面需干燥或漏水仍在排查时，应暂缓安排入住。共用走廊则单独确认客人动线、噪声窗口及清洁检查，不混用客房时间表。

title.en: Match the task to its return-to-use conditions
title.zh: 按恢复使用条件区分任务

rows.zh: 整体组合、型号、对位与操作

rows.en: Extent, substrate, moisture history and matching finish
rows.zh: 范围、基层、受潮经过和饰面匹配

rows.en: Confirm substrate condition and material requirements
rows.zh: 确认基层状况及材料要求

rows.en: Installed system, preparation and product instructions
rows.zh: 既有系统、基层准备与产品要求

rows.en: Meet the applicable drying or curing conditions
rows.zh: 满足对应干燥或固化条件

rows.en: Area served, service interruption and parts
rows.zh: 服务区域、设施停用及配件

rows.en: Complete checks and confirm the system returned to use
rows.zh: 完成检查并确认设施恢复

title.en: Confirm the repair before reserving the window
title.zh: 先明确修复，再预留窗口

paragraphs.en: Gyprock maintenance guidance distinguishes surface damage from damage involving the plasterboard core and other more substantial conditions. We therefore identify the affected board and supporting condition before defining preparation, replacement and finish work.
paragraphs.zh: Gyprock 维护资料区分表面损伤、涉及石膏板芯材的损坏及其他较重情况。因此，我们先核对板材和相关基层现状，再定义准备、更换与饰面工作。

paragraphs.en: For door faults, we consider the door, frame and related hardware together. ASSA ABLOY care guidance supports checking the complete assembly. Replacement parts and any surrounding finish repair are recorded separately from adjustment work.
paragraphs.zh: 门故障会连同门体、门框和相关五金核对；ASSA ABLOY 维护资料也考虑完整组合。替换配件、周边饰面恢复和调整工作分别列明。

paragraphs.en: Record next occupancy, work position and release contact. Set separate release times for hardware checks and finish drying.
paragraphs.zh: 记录下次入住、维修部位和放房负责人，分别安排五金复核及饰面干燥后的放房时间。

title.en: Sequence the work through the room

text.en: Your nominated contact confirms keys, room status and nearby occupancy. We agree furniture protection, material entry and the route for waste.
text.zh: 指定联系人确认钥匙、房态与附近入住情况；我们确定家具保护、材料进场和废物路线。

text.en: Investigation, opening-up and related service work are ordered before patching and final finishes where the task requires that sequence.
text.zh: 涉及相应任务时，调查、局部打开及关联设施工作安排在修补和最终饰面之前。

text.en: We check the work included in the scope, remove agreed waste and record any remaining condition before the room returns to use.
text.zh: 我们复核约定工作、清走范围内废物，并记录交还客房前仍需满足的条件。

title.en: Account for the rooms beyond the work area
title.zh: 同时考虑施工房间以外的影响

paragraphs.en: Map areas served by equipment and agree who coordinates interruptions, nearby occupancy, cleaning and noise-sensitive periods.
paragraphs.zh: 标明设备服务区域，明确停用协调人、邻近入住、清洁和对噪声敏感的时段。

paragraphs.en: AIRAH maintenance guidance stresses equipment information and defined maintenance tasks. Existing asset details and operation or maintenance records help us distinguish a routine service, a fault investigation and a parts-dependent repair.
paragraphs.zh: AIRAH 维护资料重视设备信息和明确维护任务。现有设备资料与运行、保养记录，有助于我们区分常规维护、故障调查和需要配件的维修。

title.en: Group a longer list without losing control

text.en: We group work by room, level or shared area, identify repeat parts and confirm which spaces can be released together.
text.zh: 我们按客房、楼层或公共区域归并工作，识别重复配件，并确认哪些空间可同时交出。

text.en: Each item keeps its location reference. Outstanding materials, a return visit or a finish awaiting the required condition are listed explicitly.
text.zh: 每项保留位置编号，未到材料、再次进场或等待满足条件的饰面工作明确列出。

title.en: Give the next shift a clear handover
title.zh: 让下一班拿到清楚交付

paragraphs.en: We provide completed items, relevant photographs and the checks actually carried out. The room-release record states any outstanding restriction or follow-up agreed for the job. No fixed turnaround is assumed for every repair; the materials, investigation and available access determine the plan.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提供完成项目、相关照片和实际检查。房间交出记录列明约定的尚存使用条件或后续事项；每项维修的安排结合材料、调查与可进场条件确定。

kicker.zh: 海岸维护笔记／酒店运营

deck.en: We turn room availability into a defined task list, with parts, protection, trade sequence and reopening conditions agreed before attendance.
deck.zh: 我们把客房可用时间转成明确任务清单，进场前确认配件、保护、工种顺序和重新开放条件。

lead.en: The useful question is which work can be completed and handed back under the conditions available. A latch adjustment, a damaged wall finish and a wet ceiling need different assessment and materials. We define the job first, then agree the room-release window with your manager.
lead.zh: 安排维护时，需要明确在现有条件下哪些工作可以完成并交还。锁舌调整、墙面饰面损坏和受潮吊顶，对检查及材料的要求不同。我们先定义任务，再与负责人确认客房交出窗口。

metaDescription.en: We turn room availability into a defined task list, with parts, protection, trade sequence and reopening conditions agreed before attendance.
metaDescription.zh: 我们把客房可用时间转成明确任务清单，进场前确认配件、保护、工种顺序和重新开放条件。

q.en: What helps you assess a room repair before attendance?
q.zh: 进场前提供什么有助于判断客房维修？

a.en: A room number, a short fault history, photographs of the item and surrounding area, known model details and the available access window. We identify any further inspection needed before confirming the full scope.
a.zh: 房号、简要问题经过、部件及周边照片、已知型号和进场窗口都很有用。确认完整范围前，我们会列明需要进一步检查的项目。

q.en: Can we sell a room as soon as the visible work is finished?
q.zh: 表面工作结束后就可以重新售房吗？

a.en: Record drying, curing, operation checks and connected services against room release conditions.
a.zh: 按房间恢复使用的要求记录干燥、固化、功能检查和配套设施状态。

leadTitle.zh: 把任务放进可用交房窗口。
